name: Practiced Piercer (Ex)
body:
Through frequency of use, your ability to overpower magical resistances gains strength. For the purpose of overcoming the spell resistance, you gain a +1 bonus to your caster level for every 3 caster levels that you possess. You must be at least 10th level to select this arcane discovery.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
